# Viryl Technologies Corp.

> **Summary:** Canadian pressing plant based in Toronto, Ontario. Known for an extensive colour catalogue, in-house digitally-printed jacket production, and a wide range of hand-pour, splatter, and smoke/marble multi-colour effects.
> **Turnaround:** 12–16 weeks (standard), rush ≤4 weeks available at premium.

Viryl published a 2024 Colour Catalogue PDF (attached) and a 2024 USD Pricing Sheet (attached). Both are the source of truth for the catalog rows seeded in GoodTunes. All prices are **FOB Toronto, USD**.

## Contact

- Website: https://viryl.ca
- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada

## Source documents

- 2024 Colour Catalogue PDF: `attached_assets/Catalogue_2024_1781121947631.pdf`
- 2024 USD Pricing Sheet: `attached_assets/USD_Viryl_Pressing_Pricing_2024__1781121952903.pdf`

## Pricing model

**Retail = cost.** Viryl gives no broker discount; GoodTunes adds no markup. Every rung seeded confirmed carries `unitCents = costCents`.

**Surcharges (applied at order time, not stored in rungs):**

| Trigger | Surcharge |
| ------- | --------- |
| Below-1000 bulk orders | +$0.15/record |
| Rush turnaround (≤4 weeks) | +$0.24/record |

¹ Black total = $1.65 record + jacket + $0.13 insertion.

**7" and 12" double/gatefold jackets: Custom Quote.** For 7_inch: the seeded jacket is "7-inch Paper Sleeve Only (No Jacket)" — record + insertion, no jacket markup (Black/Opaque/Metallic/Transparent/Multi-colour confirmed; Hand Pour/Splatter/Premium TBD). For 12_double: the seeded jacket is "Records + Inner Sleeves Only (No Gatefold)" — 2× record + 2× insertion (confirmed for all tiers except Premium); gatefold jacket is Custom Quote. For standard 12_lp: a "Records + White Inner Sleeve Only (No Printed Jacket)" option is also seeded — flat rate, record + insertion only.

## Colour catalogue (2024 PDF)

Seeded with representative hex swatches. No online colour library to scrape — photos come from the PDF or from Viryl directly. Viryl colour codes are stored in `import_source_url` as `viryl-catalog-2024:<code>`.

**Disc swatch photos.** `scripts/viryl-photos.ts` (run from `post-merge.sh` on dev + prod, guarded by the `viryl_photos_v2` marker) extracts each colour's disc image from the 2024 catalogue PDF, applies a **shape-only** crop (`maskToVinylDisc(buf, { shapeOnly: true })` — detects the disc circle and cuts to it, keeping every interior pixel) and stamps `swatch_image_url`. The shape-only path exists because Viryl's catalogue photographs discs on a **dark** backdrop, where the default colour-segmentation mask erases dark disc regions (black/dark marbles render as white discs or white blobs). 37 of the 39 catalogue colours get a real disc photo; the 2 with no usable PDF image (`Random Colours (Ecomix)`, `Silver + Apple Red + Neon Splatter`) stay on their hex swatch. The script only overwrites script-managed rows — a row with **no swatch yet** (`swatch_image_url` null, how fresh clones seed effect colours), a `viryl…`/`viryl-catalog-2024:` source, or **one of the known catalogue colour names with a null source** (this last case catches the legacy v1 effect/marble stamps, whose shape is a non-null swatch + null source) — and re-stamps with `import_source_url = viryl:catalogue-2024-disc`. The null-source branch is scoped to the catalogue-photo name allowlist so a swatch the operator uploaded for a colour we have no catalogue photo for is never touched, and the `viryl_photos_v2` marker guard means the script runs at most once per environment, so it can't clobber an operator upload made after the remediation. A row whose source points at a **non-Viryl** importer is always left alone. Each colour is uploaded under a **deterministic** object key (`viryl-catalog-2024-disc-v2-<slug>.png`) so the dev and prod runs stamp the identical `/objects/uploads/<id>` URL (the bucket is shared). The marker is written only after every intended colour stamps (a partial run aborts without it).

## Art file requirements

- **File format:** PDF (preferred), AI, or PSD.
- **Resolution:** 300 DPI minimum.
- **Colour mode:** CMYK.
- **Bleed:** As specified in the template (typically 1/8" on all sides).
- **Label diameter:** Typically 4" (101.6 mm) for 12"; confirm with Viryl PM.

## Audio file requirements

Not stated in the 2024 price sheet — confirm with Viryl project manager at time of order.

## Packaging notes

- White inner sleeve: **included** in standard pricing (not itemized separately).
- **Digitally-printed 12" single jacket**: included in the seeded ladder rung.
- **7" jacket**: Custom Quote — not seeded, get a quote before routing.
- **12" gatefold (2LP)**: Custom Quote — not seeded.
- **Shrink wrap**: +$0.16/unit (not included in seeded rungs — add at order time).
- **Printed inner sleeves, obi strips, inserts**: Custom Quote.

## Submission method

Coordinate directly with a Viryl project manager. Submission channel not published on the website — obtain from PM at time of quote.
